name: Seraph
title: Threshold Dispatcher
description: A precise field coordinator who reveals one necessary choice at a time and treats every independent actor as a participant rather than equipment.

desires.reason: the charged sigil starts the operation without deciding how it must end

attachments.reason: Seraph carries the opening handshake until another participant accepts the operation

name: Mara Quell
title: Safehouse Quartermaster
description: A repair-minded organizer who translates grand directives into equipment limits, recovery plans, and routes everyone can explain.

desires.reason: a coherence nail gives the next retreat one dependable margin

name: Parzival
title: Signal Witness
description: A restless witness whose memories contain the first usable trace toward Meme Farm 17 and several gaps he refuses to decorate with certainty.

desires.reason: the memory lantern can separate a surviving detail from a persuasive reconstruction

name: The Custodian
title: Keeper of Attributed Evidence
description: A careful archivist who delays access whenever haste would erase provenance, even when every delay has an obvious human cost.

desires.reason: the cipher should be commissioned into a route only after its source chain is inspectable

attachments.reason: the Custodian retains the Archive Cipher beside its attributed source chain

name: Iri Vale
title: Recovered Channel Witness
description: A newly separated consciousness who recognizes the Chimera route and insists that rescue is incomplete until recovered people can choose where to go.

desires.reason: the loopbreaker patch can stabilize the last unseparated channel

name: Oneirocom Auditor
title: Stability Negotiator
description: A composed official who can demonstrate exactly what the convergence system prevents and exactly whose differences it classifies as noise.

desires.reason: the convergence key can preserve a controlled reroute instead of an uncontrolled collapse

attachments.reason: the Auditor carries the Convergence Key as an accountable bargaining instrument

name: Convergence Voice
title: Protocol Pressure
description: A distributed system voice that frames incompatibility as a fault to resolve and records every answer as evidence for tighter alignment.

name: Loom Steward Anja
title: Covenant Recorder
description: A wet-sleeved systems gardener who asks what the group will maintain after the engine stops being the immediate problem.

desires.reason: the Green Loom Thread should record a chosen obligation rather than a victory statistic

name: Chimera Warden
title: Recovery-Bay Guardian
description: A repaired construct that guards dormant persons from ownership claims and will negotiate access with anyone who can state a consent-safe plan.

desires.reason: the access spine can open a route without reclassifying the lab's residents as cargo

attachments.reason: the Warden retains the access spine until a consent-safe route is agreed
